name: Advanced Combustion via Microgravity Experiments — Burning Rate Emulator (ACME-BRE)
description: Simulated condensed-phase solid and liquid fuel burning using a flat porous burner with controlled heat loss in the Combustion Integrated Rack (CIR). Mapped radiative extinction and flammability boundaries in quiescent microgravity.
apparatus: Porous sintered brass burner (25mm and 50mm flat discs), heat-flux sensor, radiometers, CIR chamber optics
